reason: The opened local air district report and state/federal sources did not provide a countywide annual mean PM2.5 concentration. Available readings are station-level; aggregating monitor values would create an unsupported county statistic and conceal site variation.
nearest_data: MBARD's opened 2024 air monitoring report documents monitoring sites and attainment status but not a countywide mean: https://www.mbard.org/files/5db547d5d/23%2BAir%2BMonitoring%2BDivision%2BAnnual%2BReport%2B2024.pdf. CARB's opened report URL returned only a stub; its indexed content contains station-level 2023 values for Carmel Valley, King City, and Salinas, which were not averaged: https://ww2.arb.ca.gov/sites/default/files/2024-12/Staff_Report_PM2.5_Area_Designation_Recommendations_2024_Annual_PM2.5_NAAQS.pdf. EPA AirData/design values are monitor/design-value constructs rather than a countywide annual mean: https://www.epa.gov/air-trends/air-quality-design-values.
